title: A label carried by the flow breeds true through the reacting thermals' fission (1137 of 1142 daughters keep the parent's kind, 1 conversion in ~3900 tracks) and a 10% heat-yield advantage sweeps it to fixation on 6/6 seeds, either sign; kinds are seeded at t=200, so this is heredity plus selection between planted kinds
summary: world.py is the reacting-thermals world (20261027T0024-c49-thermals-controls, defaults unchanged) plus two labels a, b advected by the flow, made only where the cap burns (kl r a (1-a-b)) and decaying at dl 0.05 elsewhere (diffusion Dl 0.02); at t=200 every burning point is labelled a or b by the half of the box it lies in, and the heat yield is Q (1 + eps (a - b)). No division rule hands a label over: daughters keep the label because the fluid each cap burns in moves and splits with it. heredity.py (labkit's segmentation and tracker on 1-t frames of T, K=20) over seeds 0-5 and eps 0, +0.1, -0.1, T=800: at the persistent splits after labelling, daughters of the parent's kind 1137 of 1142; tracks alive >= 20 t whose kind flips 1 of 3888; median cap purity 0.91-0.99. With eps +0.1 the share of a caps rises to 0.93-1.0 on all 6 seeds (27-31 a against 0-2 b at t=800); with eps -0.1 it falls to 0-0.09 on all 6; in the neutral twin (eps 0, same seeds and labelling) it drifts to 0.04-0.67 (share.png).

finding.operator: passive label advected by the flow and made autocatalytically where the body burns (heredity through the body's own trapped fluid)
finding.control: identical neutral twin (eps 0, same seeds, same labelling) and the sign-reversed advantage (eps -0.1), seeds 0-5
finding.result: daughters keep the parent's kind at 1137/1142 persistent splits; conversions 1/3888 tracks; final share of a 0.93-1.0 (eps +0.1, 6/6), 0-0.09 (eps -0.1, 6/6), 0.04-0.67 (eps 0)

limits: Variation does not arise during the run: the two kinds are planted at t=200 (half-box labelling), so by RUBRIC L7 this tests heredity and selection between seeded kinds, not selection on new variants; a trait-blind mutation operator is the next step. The label sets the heat yield directly (a written fitness effect), and the labels are autocatalytic copies, which is what keeps a cap pure. heredity.py's segmentation counts more persistent splits than the labkit pack on the same run (62 vs 36 for seed 0, eps 0.1), so split counts are relative. 128^2, T=800, one parameter point; no dt/2 or resolution test of the label.
